meta.frame: raw AC3D frame of Models/c172-common.ac (m; +x aft, +y up, +z left) - overlays assets/web/c172p.gltf.json directly
meta.formula:
(column vectors; A maps AC axes to FlightGear model axes):
    A = [[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]          AC (x,y,z) -> FG (x,-z,y)    (SimGear ACProcessPolicy)
    T_o(f) = Rz(heading) . Rx(roll) . Ry(pitch) . f + (x_m, y_m, z_m)   (SGReaderWriterXML: osg
             makeRotate(pitch,Y, roll,X, heading,Z) * makeTranslate; pitch applied first)
    ac_out = A^T . T_1( S_1( T_2( S_2( ... A . ac_in ))))
where T_k are the <offsets> of the k-th <model> include and S_k the included file's own <offsets>.
The top file's own offsets (c172p.xml pitch -3 deg) are not applied: the exterior is also raw.
meta.defaults_policy: c172p panel (not glass), bushkit 0, garmin196/digital clock/rudder trim/control lock hidden, fuel BOTH, baggage empty; other properties 0/false (cold and dark). Rest pose of all property-driven translate/rotate animations (not applied).
